question: Najväčšie študentské mestečko v Bratislave všetci volajú jednoducho Mlyny. Čo kedysi naozaj stálo v tom údolí a dalo mu meno?
source_excerpt: Located in the district of Karlova Ves, the name translates as “Mill Valley,” reflecting the area’s historical roots in agriculture and milling.

extra.why_interesting: Generations of students say 'bývam na Mlynoch' without thinking about it. Most assume it's just a dorm nickname, but it is an old place name tied to real mills on a real stream. Players can reason it out from the word itself, which gives a satisfying 'of course' moment.
extra.verification_notes: Mlynská dolina (Mlyny) is named after the water mills on the Vydrica stream, documented from 1455; I found no contradicting source (https://audiala.com/cs/slovensko/bratislava/mlynska-ulica).

explanation: Mlynská dolina dostala meno podľa vodných mlynov, ktoré kedysi poháňal potok Vydrica. Dnes tam namiesto mlynárov bývajú tisícky študentov.
